sbh1.2:1.1: The MS lacks the opening of the avatārabhūmi (Shukla p. 25 n. 1); it survives in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.2:1.5: Printed *gotrasthā(naṁ) cā(bhi)dhyāyi(yo)*, letters indistinct (Shukla p. 25 n. 2); read *gotrasthaḥ, na cādyāpi* ‘but has not yet’ (Xuanzang 而未獲得, T1579 juan 21; cf. 1.19).
sbh1.2:1.15: Printed text skips from one *parinirvāty ayam ucyate* to the next, losing the close of the middle-roots definition and the body of the strong-roots one; Xuanzang has both (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.2:1.19: Printed *na cādhmāyi yī*; read *na cādyāpi* ‘not yet’ (Xuanzang 而未, T1579 juan 21; cf. 1.5).
sbh1.2:4.20: Printed *śṛṇoti vā kaṇḍati vā*; *kaṇḍati* is corrupt and not rendered (Xuanzang 或全未聞, T1579 juan 21).
